shortlist.title: Roles Registry
shortlist.summary: Who's who and which document governs them.

documents.title: Charter
documents.summary: Sets the DAO's principles and structure of authority — what the DAO stands for and who holds power.

documents.title: DAO Parameters Registry
documents.summary: The single place that holds every adjustable number — voting thresholds, quorums, time limits, budget caps — so they can be updated by vote without touching the core documents.

groups.name: How decisions get made and carried out

documents.title: Proposal & Voting Framework
documents.summary: How a proposal is created, discussed, voted on, and approved — the DAO's core decision-making pipeline.

documents.title: Execution & Treasury Actions Policy
documents.summary: How an approved decision is actually carried out, and who is authorised to execute it.

documents.title: Treasury Signers Operational Rules
documents.summary: The rules for the people who move treasury funds — execution agents with strictly limited authority, not decision-makers.

documents.title: On-Chain Identifiers & Verification Policy
documents.summary: The public register of the DAO's governance and treasury on-chain addresses — what each one is, how it's used, and a link to verify it on the Radix explorer.

documents.title: RAC Mandate
documents.summary: Defines the Accountability Council — the guardian that makes sure governance processes are followed correctly, without itself becoming a ruler.

documents.title: Delegate Mandate
documents.summary: Defines the Delegates who perform the DAO's operational jobs (treasury signing, compliance, legal signing, etc.) — again, agents who execute, never govern.

documents.title: Elections & Role Governance Policy
documents.summary: How every key role is elected, evaluated, and replaced, keeping all authority time-bound and accountable to voters.

documents.title: Working Group Framework
documents.summary: How the DAO's execution teams (Working Groups) are created, funded, bounded, and held to their mandates.

documents.title: Roles Registry
documents.summary: A navigation aid (not a rulebook) that maps every role to the documents that define and govern it.

documents.title: Code of Conduct
documents.summary: The minimum standards of behaviour expected of everyone who participates in the DAO.

documents.title: Conflict of Interest Policy
documents.summary: When people in positions of authority must disclose personal interests and step back from a decision.

documents.title: Dispute Resolution & Arbitration Policy
documents.summary: How disagreements are resolved fairly — settled at the lowest level where possible, escalating to a vote, and ultimately to legal arbitration.

documents.title: Emergency & Safeguards Policy
documents.summary: What counts as an emergency, who may act, and the limits that keep emergency powers exceptional, minimal, temporary, and accountable.

documents.title: Governance Continuity Framework
documents.summary: How the DAO keeps governing — or recovers — if a body fails, execution is blocked, or normal processes stop working.

documents.title: Contributor Compensation Policy
documents.summary: How people who do paid work for the DAO are compensated, and how that pay is set, approved, and disclosed.

documents.title: Contributor Onboarding and Offboarding
documents.summary: How contributors join and leave cleanly, protecting continuity of work and access control.

groups.name: Protecting the DAO's code and IP

documents.title: Source Code Stewardship Policy
documents.summary: How the DAO preserves, maintains, and keeps community control over the software it holds.

documents.title: Open Source & IP Policy
documents.summary: Ensures everything the DAO funds or produces stays an open, reusable public good and can't be privatised.

documents.title: Governance Maintenance & Upgrade Framework
documents.summary: The rules for changing the rules — how governance documents are maintained, amended, and versioned over time.

documents.title: Compliance Operations Policy
documents.summary: The day-to-day procedures for meeting the Company's legal obligations (identity checks, credential security, handling regulatory demands).
